full_page.content:
1931, November
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original notes by the Servant of God Fr. Solanus Casey OFM Cap. (his notebook No. 5)
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 1
Blank page.
Page 2
Nov. 22 (Rev.) a lutheran minister Hugo Johnson - 50 - Enrolled in Ser. Mass As'n. in Febr'y 1929 - a "healer" - received his Ist Com- munion last Ascention was confirmed To-night at Our Lady Gate of Heaven Church .. a happy Hugo Francis Johnson. .
"Mission Band holds annual Exhibit. Fine showing indeed ...
Nov. 25
Sixty-one To-day . Deo Gr. John H. John H. Fischer - 60 - (1659) Abbott St. - Enrolled in S.M.S. Nov. 10th 1930. Seemed atheistic at time, wife has been Catholic. Two Children - 17 and 9. became Catholic Oct. 10, 1931 - died Nov. Ist happy. Wife had come back to church, little one baptized and youth ( 17) is taking instruc- tions. Deo Gr.
Frank Rademacher - 22 - of 3905 Lakewood - doctoring over 3 yrs . with infected eye. Costing close to $700.00 and much pain - now worse than ever. Enrolled To-night as perpetual Mem. (1932) January 2 - reports very encouraging - eye saved and 90% improved.
To-day .... little boy thought to be dying in Kiefer Hospital. . .. . Enrolled, is well again
Miss Cole proposed to pay passage for me to Ireland ....
Page 3
Nov. 28 Grace McCarten (25) in bed almost 3 yrs. (12th of Jan 3 yrs.) - T.B. - staying with neighbor (a relief room step-ma) Was taken to Hosp. a week ago (Nov. 21) for operation apendicitis. Neighbor Miis Clancy who became her mother when taken down. . . has been en- rolling Poor Souls perpetually every month for 18 month in her favor after enroling the patient her-self perpetually. and .... March 13th, 1947, last I heard G. McC. was supporting herself working about two years ago.
Marg. Koss - 29 - Troubled with sinus and ears, fears another oper- ation. Starts novena to Imm. Mother to-morrow, Enrolled for year - promising perpetual.
Guss Schneider 47 of Ecorse - cancer of intestines - wife & 5 to care for ... Enrolled a few weeks ago.
